summary: [Escalation] P0: Streaming responses hang on /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compat) in us-east for multiple customers
description:
Issue summary:
- Escalation / incident: starting ~10:05 UTC, customers report streamed responses hang: they receive headers + sometimes the first delta, then no further events. Non-streaming mode is less impacted.

Impact:
- High: user-facing chat experiences stuck loading.
- Increased cancellations and retries, elevated gateway concurrency.

Detection:
- Support escalations + internal canary tests.
- Gateway metric: open_streams gauge climbs, tokens_out drops.

Investigation notes:
- Correlated with edge-proxy config rollout earlier today.
- Hypothesis: buffering enabled on SSE route causing events not flushed under certain compression settings.

Mitigation:
- Roll back edge-proxy config in us-east; streaming recovers immediately.

Resolution:
- Permanent fix: disable response buffering + compression for SSE endpoints in openai-compat listener; add config guard.
comments: rishi_malhotra (Support lead): Tracking as escalation P0. Reports coming from 3 enterprise accounts; all on us-east.
david_kim (SRE): Confirmed with internal repro. Rolling back edge config now.
david_kim (SRE): Rollback completed 10:44 UTC; open_streams dropping; tokens_out normalizing.
maya_srinivasan (Eng-API): We'll land a guardrail to prevent buffering/compression on SSE paths.
rishi_malhotra (Support lead): Customers confirm recovery. Closing ticket and linking PR + follow-up.
david_kim (SRE): Follow-up PR merged redwood#18611; will re-roll config with fix next maintenance window.
